A white-label practice-management platform combining website, clients, bookings, memberships, forms and payments in one branded system, sold as a licensed product.

Two PHP apps in one repository: a client application and a central licensing server that signs licenses with Ed25519 and controls each customer's modules, including Booking, Membership, Forms, Coaching and Stripe payments.

Ships in English and French, with automated CI on MySQL and MariaDB and packaged releases (currently v1.6.2).

<main class="sb-main sb-main--wide" id="main"><section class="sb-section sb-bg--surface-primary sb-py-md sb-md-py-lg"><div class="sb-section__inner sb-w-wide sb-gap-xs sb-cols-1 sb-md-cols-1"><div class="sb-block sb-block--layout-container sb-align-left"><div class="sb-container sb-container--constrained sb-container--align-center"><div class="sb-block sb-block--portfolio-nav-header sb-align-left"><style id="sb-portfolio-styles">/**
 * Studio Freelancer Portfolio — Ultra-Premium Obsidian Theme Stylesheet.
 * Designed for high-end product design consultants, fractional architects, and elite developers.
 */

/* ── 1. Global Obsidian Canvas & Typography Overrides ─────────── */
:root {
    --sb-port-bg: #06080f;
    --sb-port-bg-alt: #0b0f19;
    --sb-port-surface: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.72);
    --sb-port-surface-hover: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85);
    --sb-port-surface-active: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.95);
    --sb-port-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    --sb-port-border-hover: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.45);
    --sb-port-border-glow: rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.3);
    --sb-port-text-primary: #f8fafc;
    --sb-port-text-secondary: #94a3b8;
    --sb-port-text-muted: #64748b;
    --sb-port-accent: #6366f1;
    --sb-port-accent-light: #818cf8;
    --sb-port-accent-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #8b5cf6 50%, #d946ef 100%);
    --sb-port-heading-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 25%, #cbd5e1 75%, #94a3b8 100%);
    --sb-port-glow: 0 0 40px -10px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.35);
    --sb-port-card-shadow: 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

/* Force dark luxury background across entire document */
html,
body,
body.sb-page,
main.sb-main,
section.sb-section,
.sb-section__inner {
    background-color: var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary) !important;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Inter", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif !important;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body.sb-page {
    background: 
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.18) 0%, rgba(6, 8, 15, 0.98) 55%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 90% 80%, rgba(217, 70, 239, 0.06) 0%, transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 10% 40%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.05) 0%, transparent 40%),
        var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    min-height: 100vh;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    line-height: 1.6;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
}

/* Fluid Spacing & Safe Gutters */
*, *::before, *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

section.sb-section,
.sb-layout-section {
    padding: clamp(36px, 6vw, 72px) 0 !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

section.sb-section:first-of-type {
    padding-top: clamp(16px, 3vw, 32px) !important;
}

.sb-container,
.sb-section__inner {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 1200px !important;
    margin-left: auto !important;
    margin-right: auto !important;
    padding-left: clamp(16px, 5vw, 36px) !important;
    padding-right: clamp(16px, 5vw, 36px) !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

/* Universal Heading & Text Styling */
.sb-heading, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary) !important;
    font-family: inherit !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.035em !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
}

h1.sb-heading,
.sb-heading[level="h1"] {
    font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4.25rem) !important;
    line-height: 1.08 !important;
    background: var(--sb-port-heading-gradient) !important;
    -webkit-background-clip: text !important;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent !important;
    margin-bottom: 24px !important;
}

h2.sb-heading,
.sb-heading[level="h2"] {
    font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem) !important;
    line-height: 1.15 !important;
    margin-top: 0 !important;
    margin-bottom: 16px !important;
}

.sb-text {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary) !important;
    font-size: 1.1rem !important;
    line-height: 1.7 !important;
    max-width: 720px;
}

.sb-text--base {
    font-size: 1.05rem !important;
}

.sb-text--lg {
    font-size: 1.25rem !important;
    color: #cbd5e1 !important;
    line-height: 1.65 !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

/* Remove default white site chrome */
.sb-site-header,
.sb-site-footer {
    display: none !important;
}

.sb-platform-signature {
    background: var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--sb-port-border) !important;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-muted) !important;
    padding: 24px 0 !important;
}

/* ── 2. Buttons & Actions Upgrade ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-button {
    display: inline-flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em !important;
    border-radius: 12px !important;
    padding: 14px 28px !important;
    font-size: 1rem !important;
    transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
}

.sb-button--lg {
    padding: 16px 32px !important;
    font-size: 1.05rem !important;
    border-radius: 14px !important;
}

.sb-button--primary {
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) !important;
}

.sb-button--primary:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 35px -5px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;
}

.sb-button--outline {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) !important;
    color: #e2e8f0 !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
}

.sb-button--outline:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}

/* ── 3. Luxury Sticky Navigation Header ───────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-nav {
    position: sticky;
    top: 20px;
    z-index: 100;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    margin: 0 auto 40px auto;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1180px;
    background: rgba(11, 15, 25, 0.75);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-avatar {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.5);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-info {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-name {
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-role {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-muted);
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-links {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 28px;
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .sb-portfolio-nav-links {
        display: none;
    }
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-link {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-link:hover {
    color: #ffffff;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-cta {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 8px 18px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4);
    color: #a5b4fc;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-cta:hover {
    background: var(--sb-port-accent);
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4);
}

/* ── 4. Hero Section & Status Pill ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-status-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
    color: #34d399;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px -5px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
}

.sb-portfolio-status-dot {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background-color: #10b981;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px #10b981;
    animation: sb-port-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
}

@keyframes sb-port-pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 0.35; transform: scale(0.8); }
}

/* Section Category Eyebrow Pill */
.sb-portfolio-eyebrow {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25);
    color: var(--sb-port-accent-light);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}

/* ── 5. Stat Highlight Counter Banner ─────────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-stat-item {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01) 100%), var(--sb-port-surface);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    border: 1px solid var(--sb-port-border);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 28px 24px;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: var(--sb-port-card-shadow);
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
}

.sb-portfolio-stat-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    border-color: var(--sb-port-border-hover);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.sb-portfolio-stat-number {
    font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 3.2vw, 3rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1.05;
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.sb-portfolio-stat-label {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ── 6. Project Card Bento Widget ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-project-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01) 100%), var(--sb-port-surface);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    border: 1px solid var(--sb-port-border);
    border-radius: 24px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: var(--sb-port-card-shadow);
    transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease;
    height: 100%;
}

.sb-portfolio-project-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-6px);
    border-color: var(--sb-port-border-hover);
    box-shadow: 0 24px 50px -15px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.3), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15);
}

.sb-portfolio-project-thumb {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 260px;
    overflow: hidden;
    background: #0f172a;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--sb-port-border);
}

.sb-portfolio-project-thumb img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    transition: transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
}

.sb-portfolio-project-card:hover .sb-portfolio-project-thumb img {
    transform: scale(1.05);
}

.sb-portfolio-project-metric-badge {
    position: absolute;

<main class="sb-main sb-main--wide" id="main"><section class="sb-section sb-bg--surface-primary sb-py-md sb-md-py-lg"><div class="sb-section__inner sb-w-wide sb-gap-md sb-cols-1 sb-md-cols-1"><div class="sb-block sb-block--layout-container sb-align-left"><div class="sb-container sb-container--constrained sb-container--align-center"><div class="sb-block sb-block--portfolio-nav-header sb-align-left"><style id="sb-portfolio-styles">/**
 * Studio Freelancer Portfolio — Ultra-Premium Obsidian Theme Stylesheet.
 * Designed for high-end product design consultants, fractional architects, and elite developers.
 */

/* ── 1. Global Obsidian Canvas & Typography Overrides ─────────── */
:root {
    --sb-port-bg: #06080f;
    --sb-port-bg-alt: #0b0f19;
    --sb-port-surface: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.72);
    --sb-port-surface-hover: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85);
    --sb-port-surface-active: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.95);
    --sb-port-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    --sb-port-border-hover: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.45);
    --sb-port-border-glow: rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.3);
    --sb-port-text-primary: #f8fafc;
    --sb-port-text-secondary: #94a3b8;
    --sb-port-text-muted: #64748b;
    --sb-port-accent: #6366f1;
    --sb-port-accent-light: #818cf8;
    --sb-port-accent-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #8b5cf6 50%, #d946ef 100%);
    --sb-port-heading-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 25%, #cbd5e1 75%, #94a3b8 100%);
    --sb-port-glow: 0 0 40px -10px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.35);
    --sb-port-card-shadow: 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

/* Force dark luxury background across entire document */
html,
body,
body.sb-page,
main.sb-main,
section.sb-section,
.sb-section__inner {
    background-color: var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary) !important;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Inter", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif !important;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body.sb-page {
    background: 
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.18) 0%, rgba(6, 8, 15, 0.98) 55%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 90% 80%, rgba(217, 70, 239, 0.06) 0%, transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 10% 40%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.05) 0%, transparent 40%),
        var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    min-height: 100vh;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    line-height: 1.6;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
}

/* Fluid Spacing & Safe Gutters */
*, *::before, *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

section.sb-section,
.sb-layout-section {
    padding: clamp(36px, 6vw, 72px) 0 !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

section.sb-section:first-of-type {
    padding-top: clamp(16px, 3vw, 32px) !important;
}

.sb-container,
.sb-section__inner {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 1200px !important;
    margin-left: auto !important;
    margin-right: auto !important;
    padding-left: clamp(16px, 5vw, 36px) !important;
    padding-right: clamp(16px, 5vw, 36px) !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

/* Universal Heading & Text Styling */
.sb-heading, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary) !important;
    font-family: inherit !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.035em !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
}

h1.sb-heading,
.sb-heading[level="h1"] {
    font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4.25rem) !important;
    line-height: 1.08 !important;
    background: var(--sb-port-heading-gradient) !important;
    -webkit-background-clip: text !important;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent !important;
    margin-bottom: 24px !important;
}

h2.sb-heading,
.sb-heading[level="h2"] {
    font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem) !important;
    line-height: 1.15 !important;
    margin-top: 0 !important;
    margin-bottom: 16px !important;
}

.sb-text {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary) !important;
    font-size: 1.1rem !important;
    line-height: 1.7 !important;
    max-width: 720px;
}

.sb-text--base {
    font-size: 1.05rem !important;
}

.sb-text--lg {
    font-size: 1.25rem !important;
    color: #cbd5e1 !important;
    line-height: 1.65 !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

/* Remove default white site chrome */
.sb-site-header,
.sb-site-footer {
    display: none !important;
}

.sb-platform-signature {
    background: var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--sb-port-border) !important;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-muted) !important;
    padding: 24px 0 !important;
}

/* ── 2. Buttons & Actions Upgrade ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-button {
    display: inline-flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em !important;
    border-radius: 12px !important;
    padding: 14px 28px !important;
    font-size: 1rem !important;
    transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
}

.sb-button--lg {
    padding: 16px 32px !important;
    font-size: 1.05rem !important;
    border-radius: 14px !important;
}

.sb-button--primary {
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) !important;
}

.sb-button--primary:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 35px -5px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;
}

.sb-button--outline {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) !important;
    color: #e2e8f0 !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
}

.sb-button--outline:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}

/* ── 3. Luxury Sticky Navigation Header ───────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-nav {
    position: sticky;
    top: 20px;
    z-index: 100;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    margin: 0 auto 40px auto;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1180px;
    background: rgba(11, 15, 25, 0.75);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-avatar {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.5);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-info {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-name {
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-role {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-muted);
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-links {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 28px;
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .sb-portfolio-nav-links {
        display: none;
    }
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-link {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-link:hover {
    color: #ffffff;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-cta {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 8px 18px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4);
    color: #a5b4fc;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-cta:hover {
    background: var(--sb-port-accent);
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4);
}

/* ── 4. Hero Section & Status Pill ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-status-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
    color: #34d399;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px -5px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
}

.sb-portfolio-status-dot {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background-color: #10b981;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px #10b981;
    animation: sb-port-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
}

@keyframes sb-port-pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 0.35; transform: scale(0.8); }
}

/* Section Category Eyebrow Pill */
.sb-portfolio-eyebrow {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25);
    color: var(--sb-port-accent-light);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}

/* ── 5. Stat Highlight Counter Banner ─────────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-stat-item {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01) 100%), var(--sb-port-surface);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    border: 1px solid var(--sb-port-border);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 28px 24px;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: var(--sb-port-card-shadow);
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
}

.sb-portfolio-stat-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    border-color: var(--sb-port-border-hover);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.sb-portfolio-stat-number {
    font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 3.2vw, 3rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1.05;
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.sb-portfolio-stat-label {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ── 6. Project Card Bento Widget ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-project-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01) 100%), var(--sb-port-surface);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    border: 1px solid var(--sb-port-border);
    border-radius: 24px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: var(--sb-port-card-shadow);
    transition: transform 0.35s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), border-color 0.35s ease, box-shadow 0.35s ease;
    height: 100%;
}

.sb-portfolio-project-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-6px);
    border-color: var(--sb-port-border-hover);

<main class="sb-main sb-main--wide" id="main"><section class="sb-section sb-bg--surface-primary sb-py-md sb-md-py-lg"><div class="sb-section__inner sb-w-wide sb-gap-md sb-cols-1 sb-md-cols-1"><div class="sb-block sb-block--layout-container sb-align-left"><div class="sb-container sb-container--constrained sb-container--align-center"><div class="sb-block sb-block--portfolio-nav-header sb-align-left"><style id="sb-portfolio-styles">/**
 * Studio Freelancer Portfolio — Ultra-Premium Obsidian Theme Stylesheet.
 * Designed for high-end product design consultants, fractional architects, and elite developers.
 */

/* ── 1. Global Obsidian Canvas & Typography Overrides ─────────── */
:root {
    --sb-port-bg: #06080f;
    --sb-port-bg-alt: #0b0f19;
    --sb-port-surface: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.72);
    --sb-port-surface-hover: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85);
    --sb-port-surface-active: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.95);
    --sb-port-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    --sb-port-border-hover: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.45);
    --sb-port-border-glow: rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.3);
    --sb-port-text-primary: #f8fafc;
    --sb-port-text-secondary: #94a3b8;
    --sb-port-text-muted: #64748b;
    --sb-port-accent: #6366f1;
    --sb-port-accent-light: #818cf8;
    --sb-port-accent-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #8b5cf6 50%, #d946ef 100%);
    --sb-port-heading-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 25%, #cbd5e1 75%, #94a3b8 100%);
    --sb-port-glow: 0 0 40px -10px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.35);
    --sb-port-card-shadow: 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

/* Force dark luxury background across entire document */
html,
body,
body.sb-page,
main.sb-main,
section.sb-section,
.sb-section__inner {
    background-color: var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary) !important;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Inter", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif !important;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body.sb-page {
    background: 
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.18) 0%, rgba(6, 8, 15, 0.98) 55%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 90% 80%, rgba(217, 70, 239, 0.06) 0%, transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 10% 40%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.05) 0%, transparent 40%),
        var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    min-height: 100vh;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    line-height: 1.6;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
}

/* Fluid Spacing & Safe Gutters */
*, *::before, *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

section.sb-section,
.sb-layout-section {
    padding: clamp(36px, 6vw, 72px) 0 !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

section.sb-section:first-of-type {
    padding-top: clamp(16px, 3vw, 32px) !important;
}

.sb-container,
.sb-section__inner {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 1200px !important;
    margin-left: auto !important;
    margin-right: auto !important;
    padding-left: clamp(16px, 5vw, 36px) !important;
    padding-right: clamp(16px, 5vw, 36px) !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

/* Universal Heading & Text Styling */
.sb-heading, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary) !important;
    font-family: inherit !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.035em !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
}

h1.sb-heading,
.sb-heading[level="h1"] {
    font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4.25rem) !important;
    line-height: 1.08 !important;
    background: var(--sb-port-heading-gradient) !important;
    -webkit-background-clip: text !important;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent !important;
    margin-bottom: 24px !important;
}

h2.sb-heading,
.sb-heading[level="h2"] {
    font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem) !important;
    line-height: 1.15 !important;
    margin-top: 0 !important;
    margin-bottom: 16px !important;
}

.sb-text {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary) !important;
    font-size: 1.1rem !important;
    line-height: 1.7 !important;
    max-width: 720px;
}

.sb-text--base {
    font-size: 1.05rem !important;
}

.sb-text--lg {
    font-size: 1.25rem !important;
    color: #cbd5e1 !important;
    line-height: 1.65 !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

/* Remove default white site chrome */
.sb-site-header,
.sb-site-footer {
    display: none !important;
}

.sb-platform-signature {
    background: var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--sb-port-border) !important;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-muted) !important;
    padding: 24px 0 !important;
}

/* ── 2. Buttons & Actions Upgrade ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-button {
    display: inline-flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em !important;
    border-radius: 12px !important;
    padding: 14px 28px !important;
    font-size: 1rem !important;
    transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
}

.sb-button--lg {
    padding: 16px 32px !important;
    font-size: 1.05rem !important;
    border-radius: 14px !important;
}

.sb-button--primary {
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) !important;
}

.sb-button--primary:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 35px -5px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;
}

.sb-button--outline {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) !important;
    color: #e2e8f0 !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
}

.sb-button--outline:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}

/* ── 3. Luxury Sticky Navigation Header ───────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-nav {
    position: sticky;
    top: 20px;
    z-index: 100;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    margin: 0 auto 40px auto;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1180px;
    background: rgba(11, 15, 25, 0.75);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-avatar {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.5);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-info {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-name {
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-role {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-muted);
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-links {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 28px;
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .sb-portfolio-nav-links {
        display: none;
    }
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-link {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-link:hover {
    color: #ffffff;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-cta {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 8px 18px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4);
    color: #a5b4fc;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-cta:hover {
    background: var(--sb-port-accent);
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4);
}

/* ── 4. Hero Section & Status Pill ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-status-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
    color: #34d399;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px -5px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
}

.sb-portfolio-status-dot {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background-color: #10b981;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px #10b981;
    animation: sb-port-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
}

@keyframes sb-port-pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 0.35; transform: scale(0.8); }
}

/* Section Category Eyebrow Pill */
.sb-portfolio-eyebrow {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25);
    color: var(--sb-port-accent-light);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}

/* ── 5. Stat Highlight Counter Banner ─────────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-stat-item {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01) 100%), var(--sb-port-surface);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    border: 1px solid var(--sb-port-border);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 28px 24px;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: var(--sb-port-card-shadow);
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
}

.sb-portfolio-stat-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    border-color: var(--sb-port-border-hover);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.sb-portfolio-stat-number {
    font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 3.2vw, 3rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1.05;
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.sb-portfolio-stat-label {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ── 6. Project Card Bento Widget ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-project-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01) 100%), var(--sb-port-surface);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);

<main class="sb-main sb-main--wide" id="main"><section class="sb-section sb-bg--surface-primary sb-py-md sb-md-py-lg"><div class="sb-section__inner sb-w-wide sb-gap-md sb-cols-1 sb-md-cols-1"><div class="sb-block sb-block--layout-container sb-align-left"><div class="sb-container sb-container--constrained sb-container--align-center"><div class="sb-block sb-block--portfolio-nav-header sb-align-left"><style id="sb-portfolio-styles">/**
 * Studio Freelancer Portfolio — Ultra-Premium Obsidian Theme Stylesheet.
 * Designed for high-end product design consultants, fractional architects, and elite developers.
 */

/* ── 1. Global Obsidian Canvas & Typography Overrides ─────────── */
:root {
    --sb-port-bg: #06080f;
    --sb-port-bg-alt: #0b0f19;
    --sb-port-surface: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.72);
    --sb-port-surface-hover: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85);
    --sb-port-surface-active: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.95);
    --sb-port-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    --sb-port-border-hover: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.45);
    --sb-port-border-glow: rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.3);
    --sb-port-text-primary: #f8fafc;
    --sb-port-text-secondary: #94a3b8;
    --sb-port-text-muted: #64748b;
    --sb-port-accent: #6366f1;
    --sb-port-accent-light: #818cf8;
    --sb-port-accent-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #8b5cf6 50%, #d946ef 100%);
    --sb-port-heading-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 25%, #cbd5e1 75%, #94a3b8 100%);
    --sb-port-glow: 0 0 40px -10px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.35);
    --sb-port-card-shadow: 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

/* Force dark luxury background across entire document */
html,
body,
body.sb-page,
main.sb-main,
section.sb-section,
.sb-section__inner {
    background-color: var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary) !important;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Inter", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif !important;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body.sb-page {
    background: 
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.18) 0%, rgba(6, 8, 15, 0.98) 55%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 90% 80%, rgba(217, 70, 239, 0.06) 0%, transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 10% 40%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.05) 0%, transparent 40%),
        var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    min-height: 100vh;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    line-height: 1.6;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
}

/* Fluid Spacing & Safe Gutters */
*, *::before, *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

section.sb-section,
.sb-layout-section {
    padding: clamp(36px, 6vw, 72px) 0 !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

section.sb-section:first-of-type {
    padding-top: clamp(16px, 3vw, 32px) !important;
}

.sb-container,
.sb-section__inner {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 1200px !important;
    margin-left: auto !important;
    margin-right: auto !important;
    padding-left: clamp(16px, 5vw, 36px) !important;
    padding-right: clamp(16px, 5vw, 36px) !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

/* Universal Heading & Text Styling */
.sb-heading, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary) !important;
    font-family: inherit !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.035em !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
}

h1.sb-heading,
.sb-heading[level="h1"] {
    font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4.25rem) !important;
    line-height: 1.08 !important;
    background: var(--sb-port-heading-gradient) !important;
    -webkit-background-clip: text !important;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent !important;
    margin-bottom: 24px !important;
}

h2.sb-heading,
.sb-heading[level="h2"] {
    font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem) !important;
    line-height: 1.15 !important;
    margin-top: 0 !important;
    margin-bottom: 16px !important;
}

.sb-text {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary) !important;
    font-size: 1.1rem !important;
    line-height: 1.7 !important;
    max-width: 720px;
}

.sb-text--base {
    font-size: 1.05rem !important;
}

.sb-text--lg {
    font-size: 1.25rem !important;
    color: #cbd5e1 !important;
    line-height: 1.65 !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

/* Remove default white site chrome */
.sb-site-header,
.sb-site-footer {
    display: none !important;
}

.sb-platform-signature {
    background: var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--sb-port-border) !important;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-muted) !important;
    padding: 24px 0 !important;
}

/* ── 2. Buttons & Actions Upgrade ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-button {
    display: inline-flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em !important;
    border-radius: 12px !important;
    padding: 14px 28px !important;
    font-size: 1rem !important;
    transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
}

.sb-button--lg {
    padding: 16px 32px !important;
    font-size: 1.05rem !important;
    border-radius: 14px !important;
}

.sb-button--primary {
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) !important;
}

.sb-button--primary:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 35px -5px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;
}

.sb-button--outline {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) !important;
    color: #e2e8f0 !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
}

.sb-button--outline:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}

/* ── 3. Luxury Sticky Navigation Header ───────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-nav {
    position: sticky;
    top: 20px;
    z-index: 100;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    margin: 0 auto 40px auto;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1180px;
    background: rgba(11, 15, 25, 0.75);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-avatar {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.5);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-info {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-name {
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-role {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-muted);
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-links {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 28px;
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .sb-portfolio-nav-links {
        display: none;
    }
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-link {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-link:hover {
    color: #ffffff;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-cta {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 8px 18px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4);
    color: #a5b4fc;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-cta:hover {
    background: var(--sb-port-accent);
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4);
}

/* ── 4. Hero Section & Status Pill ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-status-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
    color: #34d399;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px -5px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
}

.sb-portfolio-status-dot {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background-color: #10b981;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px #10b981;
    animation: sb-port-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
}

@keyframes sb-port-pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    50% { opacity: 0.35; transform: scale(0.8); }
}

/* Section Category Eyebrow Pill */
.sb-portfolio-eyebrow {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 4px 12px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25);
    color: var(--sb-port-accent-light);
    font-size: 0.8rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
}

/* ── 5. Stat Highlight Counter Banner ─────────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-stat-item {
    background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03) 0%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.01) 100%), var(--sb-port-surface);
    backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px);
    border: 1px solid var(--sb-port-border);
    border-radius: 20px;
    padding: 28px 24px;
    text-align: center;
    box-shadow: var(--sb-port-card-shadow);
    transition: transform 0.25s ease, border-color 0.25s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease;
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: center;
}

.sb-portfolio-stat-item:hover {
    transform: translateY(-4px);
    border-color: var(--sb-port-border-hover);
    box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -10px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.25), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.sb-portfolio-stat-number {
    font-size: clamp(2.2rem, 3.2vw, 3rem);
    font-weight: 800;
    line-height: 1.05;
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient);
    -webkit-background-clip: text;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    letter-spacing: -0.03em;
}

.sb-portfolio-stat-label {
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.4;
}

/* ── 6. Project Card Bento Widget ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-project-card {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;

<main class="sb-main sb-main--wide" id="main"><section class="sb-section sb-bg--surface-primary sb-py-md sb-md-py-lg"><div class="sb-section__inner sb-w-wide sb-gap-md sb-cols-1 sb-md-cols-1"><div class="sb-block sb-block--layout-container sb-align-left"><div class="sb-container sb-container--constrained sb-container--align-center"><div class="sb-block sb-block--portfolio-nav-header sb-align-left"><style id="sb-portfolio-styles">/**
 * Studio Freelancer Portfolio — Ultra-Premium Obsidian Theme Stylesheet.
 * Designed for high-end product design consultants, fractional architects, and elite developers.
 */

/* ── 1. Global Obsidian Canvas & Typography Overrides ─────────── */
:root {
    --sb-port-bg: #06080f;
    --sb-port-bg-alt: #0b0f19;
    --sb-port-surface: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.72);
    --sb-port-surface-hover: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.85);
    --sb-port-surface-active: rgba(30, 41, 59, 0.95);
    --sb-port-border: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    --sb-port-border-hover: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.45);
    --sb-port-border-glow: rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.3);
    --sb-port-text-primary: #f8fafc;
    --sb-port-text-secondary: #94a3b8;
    --sb-port-text-muted: #64748b;
    --sb-port-accent: #6366f1;
    --sb-port-accent-light: #818cf8;
    --sb-port-accent-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #6366f1 0%, #8b5cf6 50%, #d946ef 100%);
    --sb-port-heading-gradient: linear-gradient(135deg, #ffffff 25%, #cbd5e1 75%, #94a3b8 100%);
    --sb-port-glow: 0 0 40px -10px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.35);
    --sb-port-card-shadow: 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6), 0 0 1px 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05);
}

/* Force dark luxury background across entire document */
html,
body,
body.sb-page,
main.sb-main,
section.sb-section,
.sb-section__inner {
    background-color: var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary) !important;
    font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Inter", "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif !important;
    -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
    -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body.sb-page {
    background: 
        radial-gradient(circle at 50% 0%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.18) 0%, rgba(6, 8, 15, 0.98) 55%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 90% 80%, rgba(217, 70, 239, 0.06) 0%, transparent 45%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 10% 40%, rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.05) 0%, transparent 40%),
        var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    min-height: 100vh;
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
    line-height: 1.6;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
}

/* Fluid Spacing & Safe Gutters */
*, *::before, *::after {
    box-sizing: border-box;
}

section.sb-section,
.sb-layout-section {
    padding: clamp(36px, 6vw, 72px) 0 !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

section.sb-section:first-of-type {
    padding-top: clamp(16px, 3vw, 32px) !important;
}

.sb-container,
.sb-section__inner {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 1200px !important;
    margin-left: auto !important;
    margin-right: auto !important;
    padding-left: clamp(16px, 5vw, 36px) !important;
    padding-right: clamp(16px, 5vw, 36px) !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
}

/* Universal Heading & Text Styling */
.sb-heading, h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary) !important;
    font-family: inherit !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.035em !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
}

h1.sb-heading,
.sb-heading[level="h1"] {
    font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5.5vw, 4.25rem) !important;
    line-height: 1.08 !important;
    background: var(--sb-port-heading-gradient) !important;
    -webkit-background-clip: text !important;
    -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent !important;
    margin-bottom: 24px !important;
}

h2.sb-heading,
.sb-heading[level="h2"] {
    font-size: clamp(1.85rem, 3.5vw, 2.75rem) !important;
    line-height: 1.15 !important;
    margin-top: 0 !important;
    margin-bottom: 16px !important;
}

.sb-text {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary) !important;
    font-size: 1.1rem !important;
    line-height: 1.7 !important;
    max-width: 720px;
}

.sb-text--base {
    font-size: 1.05rem !important;
}

.sb-text--lg {
    font-size: 1.25rem !important;
    color: #cbd5e1 !important;
    line-height: 1.65 !important;
    font-weight: 400 !important;
}

/* Remove default white site chrome */
.sb-site-header,
.sb-site-footer {
    display: none !important;
}

.sb-platform-signature {
    background: var(--sb-port-bg) !important;
    border-top: 1px solid var(--sb-port-border) !important;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-muted) !important;
    padding: 24px 0 !important;
}

/* ── 2. Buttons & Actions Upgrade ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-button {
    display: inline-flex !important;
    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
    font-weight: 600 !important;
    letter-spacing: -0.01em !important;
    border-radius: 12px !important;
    padding: 14px 28px !important;
    font-size: 1rem !important;
    transition: all 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) !important;
    text-decoration: none !important;
    cursor: pointer !important;
}

.sb-button--lg {
    padding: 16px 32px !important;
    font-size: 1.05rem !important;
    border-radius: 14px !important;
}

.sb-button--primary {
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25) !important;
}

.sb-button--primary:hover {
    transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
    box-shadow: 0 16px 35px -5px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.6), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;
}

.sb-button--outline {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04) !important;
    color: #e2e8f0 !important;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15) !important;
    backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px) !important;
}

.sb-button--outline:hover {
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08) !important;
    border-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) !important;
    color: #ffffff !important;
    transform: translateY(-2px) !important;
}

/* ── 3. Luxury Sticky Navigation Header ───────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-nav {
    position: sticky;
    top: 20px;
    z-index: 100;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    margin: 0 auto 40px auto;
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 1180px;
    background: rgba(11, 15, 25, 0.75);
    backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
    border-radius: 9999px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px -10px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-brand {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    text-decoration: none;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-avatar {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--sb-port-accent-gradient);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-weight: 800;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    color: #fff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.5);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-info {
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-name {
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 0.95rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-primary);
}

.sb-portfolio-brand-role {
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: var(--sb-port-text-muted);
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-links {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 28px;
    list-style: none;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .sb-portfolio-nav-links {
        display: none;
    }
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-link {
    color: var(--sb-port-text-secondary);
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 0.9rem;
    font-weight: 500;
    transition: color 0.2s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-link:hover {
    color: #ffffff;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-cta {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 6px;
    padding: 8px 18px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.15);
    border: 1px solid rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4);
    color: #a5b4fc;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.2s ease;
}

.sb-portfolio-nav-cta:hover {
    background: var(--sb-port-accent);
    color: #ffffff;
    box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(99, 102, 241, 0.4);
}

/* ── 4. Hero Section & Status Pill ────────────────────────────── */
.sb-portfolio-status-pill {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 16px;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background: rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.1);
    border: 1px solid rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.3);
    color: #34d399;
    font-size: 0.85rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 0.03em;
    margin-bottom: 24px;
    box-shadow: 0 0 20px -5px rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.2);
}

.sb-portfolio-status-dot {
    width: 8px;
    height: 8px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background-color: #10b981;
    box-shadow: 0 0 10px #10b981;
    animation: sb-port-pulse 2s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.6, 1) infinite;
}

@keyframes sb-port-pulse {
    0%, 100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
